   current[i]=n

  if a.n~=b.n then return a.n>b.n end

-- 全局库存分配先解净变化方程；最后两个独立作物由方程直接求解，

  if first and at==#order-1 then
   local i,j=order[at],order[at+1];local v,w=vectors[i],vectors[j];local det=v[1]*w[2]-v[2]*w[1]

  local x,y=0,0;for i=1,#crops do x=x+a[i]*a[i];y=y+b[i]*b[i] end

-- 固定目标株数后联立“总株数+两维净变化”，直接解出最多三个作物数量。
-- 同属性作物按库存排序，只枚举可通过整体改名覆盖的规范代表。
function M.TargetAllocations(crops,stock,vectors,target,defs,yieldfn,node_limit)
 local K=#crops
 local function Det(i,j,k)
  local a,b,c=vectors[i],vectors[j],vectors[k]

 end

  local w=(stock[crops[i]]+1)*(stock[crops[j]]+1)*(stock[crops[k]]+1)

 end end end
 if #pivots==0 then
  for i=1,K do for j=i+1,K do
   local a,b=vectors[i],vectors[j];local w=(stock[crops[i]]+1)*(stock[crops[j]]+1)

 local pivotSet={};for _,i in ipairs(pivots) do pivotSet[i]=true end
 local order={};for i=1,K do if not pivotSet[i] then order[#order+1]=i end end
 table.sort(order,function(a,b)return stock[crops[a]]~=stock[crops[b]] and stock[crops[a]]<stock[crops[b]] or stock[crops[a]]==stock[crops[b]] and a<b end)
 for _,i in ipairs(pivots) do order[#order+1]=i end

  local key=table.concat(vectors[i],',')..':'..(defs[k].family_min_count or 4)..':'..(defs[k].family_check_dist or 4)
  if not groups[key] then groups[key]={} end;groups[key][#groups[key]+1]=i;groupof[i]=groups[key]
 end

  table.sort(group,function(a,b)return stock[crops[a]]~=stock[crops[b]] and stock[crops[a]]>stock[crops[b]] or stock[crops[a]]==stock[crops[b]] and a<b end)

 local nodes,limited=0,false

  if nodes%128==0 and yieldfn then yieldfn() end
  if total>target or total+suffix[at]<target then return end

  if at==K-#pivots+1 then
   local R=target-total;local values={}
   if #pivots==3 then
    local i,j,k=pivots[1],pivots[2],pivots[3];local a,b,c=vectors[i],vectors[j],vectors[k]

    local w=((b[1]-a[1])*by-(b[2]-a[2])*bx)/det

   elseif #pivots==2 then
    local a,b=vectors[pivots[1]],vectors[pivots[2]];local axis=a[1]~=b[1] and 1 or 2
    local v=((axis==1 and -x or -y)-R*b[axis])/(a[axis]-b[axis]);values={v,R-v}
   else values={R} end
   local xx,yy=x,y;local ok=true
   for q,i in ipairs(pivots) do
    local n=values[q]
    if not Allowed(i,n) then ok=false;break end
    counts[i]=n;assigned[i]=true;xx=xx+n*vectors[i][1];yy=yy+n*vectors[i][2]
   end
   if ok and xx==0 and yy==0 then Store() end
   for _,i in ipairs(pivots) do assigned[i]=nil;counts[i]=nil end
   return
  end
  local i=order[at];local v=vectors[i]
  for n=math.min(stock[crops[i]],target-total),0,-1 do if Allowed(i,n) then
   counts[i]=n;assigned[i]=true;Search(at+1,total+n,x+n*v[1],y+n*v[2]);assigned[i]=nil;counts[i]=nil
   if limited then break end
  end end
 end
 if K>0 then Search(1,0,0,0) end
 table.sort(profiles,function(a,b)
  local x,y=0,0;for i=1,K do if a[i]>0 then x=x+1 end;if b[i]>0 then y=y+1 end end
  if x~=y then return x<y end
  for i=1,K do if a[i]~=b[i] then return a[i]>b[i] end end
  return false
 end)

end
return M
modules.aom_seed_strategy:
--[[
	Tractor —— 播种策略

	三种策略：
	  1. SEQUENTIAL 按种子顺序播种
	  2. GIANT_TEMPLATE 巨大化·模版
	  3. GIANT          巨大化·最优（保留旧存档标识）

	自动规划由 aom_auto_seeding 管理。
]]

local AOMSeedStrategy = {}

-- 作物 seed -> 作物内部名 的映射依据：
-- 原版 seeds 用 components.farmplantable.plant 存"会长成什么"，
-- 对作物种子是 "farm_plant_<作物名>"（farm_plant_defs.lua:267 data.seed = veggie.."_seeds"）
-- 所以这里不依赖种子 prefab 名，而是读 plant 字段，更稳。
local PLANT_PREFIX = "farm_plant_"

-- 从种子的 farmplantable 读出它会长成哪种作物；读不出返回 nil
function AOMSeedStrategy.Normalize(mode)
    return (mode == "GIANT" or mode == "GIANT_TEMPLATE") and mode or "SEQUENTIAL"
end

function AOMSeedStrategy.IsGiant(mode)return mode == "GIANT" or mode == "GIANT_TEMPLATE" end

function AOMSeedStrategy.GetCropOfSeedItem(item)
	if item == nil or item.components.farmplantable == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local plant = item.components.farmplantable.plant
	if type(plant) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(plant, item)
		plant = ok and v or nil
	end
	if type(plant) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	if plant == "farm_plant_randomseed" then
		return nil            -- 随机种子，不属于任何具体作物
	end
	if string.sub(plant, 1, #PLANT_PREFIX) == PLANT_PREFIX then
		return string.sub(plant, #PLANT_PREFIX + 1)
	end
	return nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 策略 1：按顺序
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- 返回要种的那颗种子（保持仓内顺序）
function AOMSeedStrategy.PickSequential(item_list)
	for _, item in ipairs(item_list) do
		if item ~= nil and item:IsValid() then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 所有配比只从坐标规划器读取，避免两份数据发生漂移。
function AOMSeedStrategy.GetSeasonCombos(season)
    return require("aom_block_plan").BLOCKS[season or "autumn"]
end
function AOMSeedStrategy.GetAllCombos()
    return require("aom_block_plan").BLOCKS
end

return AOMSeedStrategy
modules.aom_farm_registry:
-- 服务端的世界级、临时农田索引。它只是缓存，播种时必须重新核对现场。
local M={}
local function Key(x,z)return string.format('%.3f:%.3f',x,z)end
local function Registry(world)
    if not world then return end
    world._aom_ready_farm_tiles=world._aom_ready_farm_tiles or {}
    return world._aom_ready_farm_tiles
end
function M.Record(world,x,z)
    local tiles=Registry(world)
    if tiles and type(x)=='number' and type(z)=='number' then tiles[Key(x,z)]={x=x,z=z} end
end
function M.Remove(world,x,z)
    local tiles=Registry(world);if tiles then tiles[Key(x,z)]=nil end
end
-- 只连上下左右；保留真实坐标。上限只限制单次规划，避免遍历整个世界。
function M.Connected(world,x,z,limit)
    local tiles=Registry(world);local queue,out,seen={}, {}, {}
    local first=tiles and tiles[Key(x,z)]
    if not first then return out,false end
    queue[1]=first;seen[Key(x,z)]=true
    local i=1
    while i<=#queue do
        local tile=queue[i];i=i+1;out[#out+1]=tile
        for _,offset in ipairs({{0,-4},{-4,0},{4,0},{0,4}}) do
            local k=Key(tile.x+offset[1],tile.z+offset[2]);local nexttile=tiles[k]
            if nexttile and not seen[k] then seen[k]=true;queue[#queue+1]=nexttile end
        end
        if limit and #out>=limit and i<=#queue then return out,true end
    end
    return out,false
end
return M
modules.aom_crop_state:
-- 作物采收与残株清理共用判定；不把正常生长、缺水或暂时禁止交互当成死亡。
local M={}
function M.IsFarmPlant(target)
    if target.components.farmplantstress~=nil or target.plant_def~=nil then return true end
    if target.weed_def~=nil or target:HasTag("weedplantstress") then return false end
    return (type(target.prefab)=="string" and string.sub(target.prefab,1,11)=="farm_plant_")
        or target:HasTag("farm_plant")
end
local function Stage(target)
    local growable=target.components.growable
    return growable and growable.GetCurrentStageData and growable:GetCurrentStageData()
end
function M.IsRotten(target)
    if not M.IsFarmPlant(target) then return false end
    if target:HasTag("farm_plant_killjoy") then return true end
    local stage=Stage(target)
    return stage~=nil and stage.name=="rotten"
end
function M.CanHarvest(target)
    if not M.IsFarmPlant(target) then return false end
    local pickable=target.components.pickable
    return pickable~=nil and pickable:CanBePicked()
end
function M.CanClearRemains(target)
    if not M.IsFarmPlant(target) then return false end
    local pickable=target.components.pickable
    -- 可采收腐烂株留给收割机；禁用交互/被卡住也不能改走铲除绕过限制。
    if pickable and (pickable:CanBePicked() or pickable.caninteractwith==false or pickable.stuck) then return false end
    if M.IsRotten(target) or target:HasTag("deadplant") then return true end
    local stage=Stage(target)
    if stage and stage.name=="dead" then return true end
    local health=target.components.health
    return health~=nil and health:IsDead()
end
return M
modules.components/aom_attachment_store:
--[[
	Tractor —— 挂件物料仓

	设计原则（按评审意见重写）：
	- 不再用"隐藏实体"存物品。隐藏实体不会恢复显示、读档会丢状态，是错误做法。
	- 种子 / 肥料：用原版 container 组件真实持有，容器自带 OnSave/OnLoad，
	  物品始终是正常实体，读档、换挂件、死亡都安全。
	- 水：属于**洒水机自身**的状态（像洒水壶的剩余次数），存在挂件的
	  finiteuses 上，换挂件、读档都不会丢。

	所以本组件只做一个薄壳：持有容器引用 + 提供取料接口。
]]

local AttachmentStore = Class(function(self, inst)
	self.inst = inst
	-- 底盘初始化时绑定原版Container货仓，配件由独立挂点持有
	self.container = nil
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 水：存在挂件自身的 finiteuses 上
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function WaterUses(self)
    local item=self:_GetAttachment()
    return item and item.attachment_type==AOM_ATTACHMENT_TYPE.IRRIGATOR and item.components.finiteuses or nil
end

function AttachmentStore:GetWater()
    local uses=WaterUses(self)
    return uses and math.max(0,math.min(uses.total,math.floor(uses:GetUses()))) or 0
end

function AttachmentStore:GetWaterMax()
    local uses=WaterUses(self)
    return uses and uses.total or 0
end

function AttachmentStore:AddWater(amount)
    local uses=WaterUses(self)
    if not uses or type(amount)~="number" or amount~=amount then return 0 end
    local add=math.max(0,math.min(math.floor(amount),self:GetWaterMax()-self:GetWater()))
    if add>0 then
        uses:SetUses(self:GetWater()+add)
        self.inst:PushEvent("aom_water_changed")
    end
    return add
end

function AttachmentStore:TakeWater()
    local uses=WaterUses(self)
    if not uses or self:GetWater()<1 then return false end
    uses:Use(1)
    self.inst:PushEvent("aom_water_changed")
    return true
end

function AttachmentStore:ReturnWater()
    return self:AddWater(1)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 获取当前挂件物品
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AttachmentStore:_GetAttachment()
    return require("aom_attachment_mount").Get(self.inst)
end

function AttachmentStore:_GetMaterialContainer()
	return self.container
end

function AttachmentStore:SetMaterialContainer(container)
	self.container = container
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 种子
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AttachmentStore:GetSeedCount()
	local c = self.container
	if c == nil then return 0 end
	local n = 0
	for i = 1, c.numslots or 0 do
		local item = c:GetItemInSlot(i)
		if item ~= nil and item.components.farmplantable ~= nil then
			n = n + (item.components.stackable ~= nil and item.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1)
		end
	end
	return n
end

-- 列出仓里所有种子（按槽位顺序）
function AttachmentStore:ListSeeds()
	local c = self.container
	local out = {}
	if c == nil then return out end
	for i = 1, c.numslots or 0 do
		local item = c:GetItemInSlot(i)
		if item ~= nil and item:IsValid() and item.components.farmplantable ~= nil then
			table.insert(out, item)
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- 按槽位顺序取第一颗（策略 1）
function AttachmentStore:TakeSeeds()
	local list = self:ListSeeds()
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	return self:_SplitOne(self.container, list[1])
end

-- 按指定作物取一颗（策略 3：巨大化配比）
-- crop_name 为 nil 时等同于 TakeSeeds
function AttachmentStore:TakeSeedOfCrop(crop_name, get_crop_fn)
	local list = self:ListSeeds()
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	if crop_name == nil then
		return self:_SplitOne(self.container, list[1])
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(list) do
		if get_crop_fn(item) == crop_name then
			return self:_SplitOne(self.container, item)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 统计仓里每种作物各有多少颗
function AttachmentStore:CountSeedsByCrop(get_crop_fn)
	local counts = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(self:ListSeeds()) do
		local crop = get_crop_fn(item)
		if crop ~= nil then
			local n = item.components.stackable ~= nil and item.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1
			counts[crop] = (counts[crop] or 0) + n
		end
	end
	return counts
end

function AttachmentStore:ReturnSeed(item)
	local c = self.container
	if c == nil or item == nil or not item:IsValid() then
		return
	end
	c:GiveItem(item,nil,Vector3(self.inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 肥料
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AttachmentStore:ListFertilizers()
    local out={}
    local c=self.container
    if c then
        for i=1,c.numslots or 0 do
            local item=c:GetItemInSlot(i)
            if item and item:IsValid() and item.components.fertilizer then out[#out+1]=item end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- 统计真实可施用次数，包含多次用量和堆叠；不把一桶肥料算作一次。
function AttachmentStore:GetFertilizerCount()
    local n=0
    local Fertilizer=require("aom_fertilizer")
    for _,item in ipairs(self:ListFertilizers()) do n=n+Fertilizer.Doses(item) end
    return n
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 通用：往物料容器里塞一件物品（自动拆堆叠的一份）
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AttachmentStore:_SplitOne(container, item)
	-- 堆叠：只拆一份出来，剩下的留在原格
	if item.components.stackable ~= nil and item.components.stackable:StackSize() > 1 then
		return item.components.stackable:Get(1)
	end
	-- 非堆叠：整件从容器取出，实体保持有效（不 Remove）
	container:RemoveItem(item, true)
	return item
end

-- 把玩家手里的物品放进物料容器（用于"装料"动作）
function AttachmentStore:LoadItem(item,doer)
    local c=self.container
    if not c or not item or not item:IsValid() or not item.components.inventoryitem then return false end
    local ii=item.components.inventoryitem
    local owner=ii.owner
    if owner==self.inst then return false end
    local stack=item.components.stackable
    local size=stack and stack:StackSize() or 1
    local accepted=math.min(size,c:CanAcceptCount(item))
    if accepted<1 then return false end -- 不先拿走满仓时无法接纳的物品
    local source=owner and (owner.components.inventory or owner.components.container)
    local slot=ii.GetSlotNum and ii:GetSlotNum() or nil
    local origin=owner or doer or self.inst
    local pos=Vector3(origin.Transform:GetWorldPosition())
    local moved
    if accepted<size then
        moved=stack:Get(accepted)
        -- 原版 Stackable:Get 会继承原 owner，但拆出物不在原容器槽位中。
        if moved and moved.components.inventoryitem.owner then moved.components.inventoryitem:OnRemoved() end
    elseif owner then moved=ii:RemoveFromOwner(true)
    else moved=item end
    if not moved then return false end
    local before=moved.components.stackable and moved.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1
    local ok,result=pcall(c.GiveItem,c,moved,nil,pos,false)
    local left=0
    if moved:IsValid() and not (ok and result) and moved.components.inventoryitem.owner~=self.inst then
        left=moved.components.stackable and moved.components.stackable:StackSize() or 1
        if source then source:GiveItem(moved,slot,pos) end
        -- 来源已无法接回时，保留实体并放回来源位置，不能遗留无归属的隐藏物品。
        if moved:IsValid() and not moved.components.inventoryitem.owner then
            moved.Transform:SetPosition(pos:Get())
            moved.components.inventoryitem:OnDropped(true)
        end
    end
    local loaded=before-left
    if loaded>0 then self.inst:PushEvent("aom_load_changed") end
    return loaded>0,loaded
end

function AttachmentStore:OnSave()
	-- 物料由 container 自身保存；这里只记容器是否存在
	return self.container ~= nil and true or nil
end

function AttachmentStore:OnLoad(data)
end

return AttachmentStore
